ops.title: Verify TCC stable-path fix across two upgrades (v0.49.1+)

ops.text: After upgrade #1 (to v0.49.1): exactly one consent prompt; sqlite3 -readonly ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db shows a kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData row with client=/Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/bin/cc-pool. After upgrade #2 (next release): NO prompt, NO new row, ccp doctor bridge rung green. If the daemon prompt never surfaces, run 'cc-pool daemon' once from Terminal (it self-relocates then binds GUI-attached).
